items.label: 3 Pieces Patio Furniture Sets Cover
items.value: Designed for 3-piece patio furniture set,includes 1 Patio loveseat cover and 2 Patio chair covers.The chair cover size is 30" W x 34" D x 38.5" H,the loveseat cover size is 58''W x 32.5''D x 31''H.Please measure the size of your furniture before purchase

items.label: Outdoor Furniture Covers Waterproof
items.value: Our patio chair cover and outdoor loveseat cover is made of 600D heavy duty 100% waterproof oxford,double needle stitching for seams,which can prevent water and dirt get into,protect your furnitures from UV,rain,dust,leaves,bird droppings and etc,keep furnitures dry and clean

items.label: Easy to Use and Fasten
items.value: The bottom of our 3 piece outdoor furniture cover has desigend elastic hem cord and fixed buckle straps.It can be adjusted to achieve a tight custom fit.Adjustable hem cord with buckle straps provides the cover a customizable fit with exceptional security in the windy day.And big padded handles reduces the time and effort to install or remove the cover

items.label: Powerful Ventilation
items.value: There has 2 big air vents on the side of our outdoor furniture cover,which can support good air circulation when the cover is locked by buckles,you never have to worry about the cover expanding in the wind and water vapor condenses on the furnitures

items.label: Perfectly for 3 Piece Outdoor Furnitures
items.value: This outdoor patio furnitures cover is made of heavy duty Oxford fabric,double needle sewing process makes it more durable,it can withstand all kinds of bad factors,it's the perfect protector for your lawn/garden/yard furnitures,it will save your precious time and money,make your furnitures always look like new

items.label: Full Protection
items.value: Our cover can provide all-weather protection for your outdoor furnitures,it can extend the service life of your furnitures,protect your important investments.If you have any dissatisfaction with our product, please contact us directly (even outside the Amazon return window)
